title: Trifluoroacetic acid-mediated selective oxidation of arylamines to nitroarenes via in situ formed peroxytrifluoroacetic acid
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,38938-38945
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06600J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Shiyun Li, Lulu Wang, Jianyin Hu, Yan An, Jun Huang, Bin Wen, Yuanqing Dong, Tiesen Li, Xingquan Chen
Herein, an environmentally friendly approach was developed for the selective oxidation of arylamines to nitroarenes. This methodology employed 30% peroxide as the oxidant and trifluoroacetic acid (TFA) as both the solvent and reactant.
